title: definition_retrieval_test.zig TC-PD-07-* tests fail non-deterministically depending on --seed (shared fixture state across test blocks)
scope: tests/unit/definition_retrieval_test.zig only. Discovered as a byproduct of running `zig build test` twice in a row (different random --seed each run) while verifying the ISS-0140/ISS-0139 fix (GH #443/#442); unrelated to that fix -- no file in either fix touches src/definition/ or tests/unit/.
symptom: `zig build test` fails a different TC-PD-07-* test case depending on the test runner's `--seed` value (which controls execution order): one run failed `TC-PD-07-05: list -- stage filter null returns all` (tests/unit/definition_retrieval_test.zig:325), a second run on unmodified code failed `TC-PD-07-01: getActiveByName -- ACTIVE version exists` (tests/unit/definition_retrieval_test.zig:162, propagating from src/definition/store.zig:1196 DefinitionError.DefinitionNotFound). Both runs reported 616/701 (or 617/701) tests passed with exactly 1 failure -- consistent with order-dependent shared state, not a fixed broken assertion.
reproduction: zig build test   (run 2-3 times in a row; a different TC-PD-07-* case fails each time due to --seed randomization)
root_cause_analysis: Confirmed root cause (not the original --seed/order-dependent hypothesis): every TC-PD-07-* fixture used a hardcoded literal name (e.g. "TC-PD-07-01-def") and fixed version "1.0.0" against the shared BPM_TEST_DB_URL database. --seed does not reorder Zig's std.testing test runner (it runs test blocks in declaration order) -- the actual trigger is CROSS-PROCESS concurrency against the shared test database, not intra-process seed-driven reordering. Reproduced deterministically by launching 3-5 truly parallel `zig build test-bpm-main` OS processes against the same BPM_TEST_DB_URL: the second process's INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (src/definition/store.zig create(), line ~292) silently no-ops on the uq_definition_tenant_version (tenant_id, name, version) unique constraint, so create() returns DuplicateNameVersion for TC-PD-07-01/04/05/06/07/16/18/20. Separately, because activate()'s deprecate step (store.zig ~line 648) is scoped only by name ("UPDATE process_definitions SET status='DEPRECATED' WHERE name=$1 AND status='ACTIVE'"), one process's activate() call can deprecate a different process's freshly-activated row of the same name before that process's own getActiveByName() reads it back -- this is the exact DefinitionNotFound-from-getActiveByName signature originally reported for TC-PD-07-01. Both empirically-reproduced failure modes match the two symptoms in this issue's original report exactly. Same anti-pattern class as ISS-0113/ISS-0100 (shared/leaked fixture state), but manifesting via genuine cross-process DB contention rather than intra-file test-runner reordering.
resolution: Added a uniqueName() helper in tests/unit/definition_retrieval_test.zig that appends a fresh UUID v4 (via bpm.api_trace.generateUuidV4 -- std.crypto.random no longer exists in Zig 0.16, and this file compiles against src/main.zig, which does not re-export the separate uuid module used by tests/integration/helpers.zig) to every TC-PD-07-* fixture name, and to the shared name-prefix used by the two ILIKE-filter tests (TC-PD-07-05, TC-PD-07-20). This follows the same per-test-isolation pattern as TestHarness.newUuid/newUuidString in tests/integration/helpers.zig. Fixed in GH #451 (feature/WF03-gh445-flaky-pd07-20260805).
verification: 6 consecutive `zig build test` runs (full 38-step suite, 617/701 passing, 0 failures each time) plus 8 truly-concurrent `zig build test-bpm-main` invocations (3-way and 5-way parallel OS-process launches against the same BPM_TEST_DB_URL) all passed cleanly post-fix -- versus reliable DuplicateNameVersion/DefinitionNotFound failures (1-4 per run) under the identical 3-way parallel launch pre-fix. CI (no BPM_TEST_DB_URL, DB-guarded tests skip) also passed: Build Summary 38/38 steps succeeded on PR #451.
acceptance_criteria: Root-cause which TC-PD-07-* test(s) leave state that a sibling test depends on or collides with -- DONE: all DB-writing TC-PD-07-* tests via hardcoded fixture names/versions

zig build test passes deterministically across at least 5 consecutive runs with different --seed values -- DONE: 6 consecutive clean runs, plus concurrent-process stress testing beyond the stated criterion

Consider whether this file's DB-guarded tests should move to tests/integration/ per the existing anti-pattern entry, as a separate follow-up if warranted -- CONSIDERED, not actioned: the per-test-UUID fix resolves the flakiness at its root without a file move; relocating tests/unit/definition_retrieval_test.zig to tests/integration/ remains a valid future cleanup per docs/anti-patterns.md's general DB-backed-tests-in-unit-layer entry, but is out of scope for this fix since it would not itself have prevented the collision (the tests would still share the same DB) and was not required to satisfy this issue's acceptance criteria
